definitions.probabilities: float64 exp(log_score - max) normalized over all 121301 one-/two-word candidates
definitions.ranks: 1-based descending saved score; ties record first/last ranks and markers use their midpoint
definitions.cumulative_mass: Sum of probabilities through the last rank in a tied group
definitions.zoom: Display limits only; probabilities always normalized over the complete saved distribution
definitions.score: y*ln(clip(p))+(1-y)*ln(1-clip(p)); original epsilon=1e-10; summed without participant weights
definitions.set_advantage: Set log score minus Ordering log score
definitions.pair_score_audit: Recomputed only from frozen probabilities to attribute the existing scores; no changed predictions or clipping
definitions.top_three_share: Sum of the three largest absolute pair differences divided by sum of all 30 absolute pair differences
definitions.scope: Descriptive plots and score decomposition only; no correlations, tests, model fitting, LM inference, or new samples
